name: @aotui/agent-driver-adapter
description: Connect AOTUI Runtime observations to Agent Driver contexts.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc && esbuild src/console/program-child.mts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/console/program-child.mjs && node -e "require('node:fs').copyFileSync('node_modules/acorn/LICENSE', 'dist/console/LICENSE.acorn')"
